notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
This update includes 2 modifications:

1- From now on, the volume will be saved when the game is normally closed from the title screen and 
    will be loaded when the game initialization screen is displayed. Although the game volume was not 
    initially designed to be saved, this new feature could improve the experience of some users.

2- Minor cosmetic corrections.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
This update includes two enhancements:

1- The game is now optimized for high DPI displays.

2- The game will no longer run in low resolution. Previously, some players may have experienced difficulty in adjusting their system settings to achieve a 4:3 aspect ratio, resulting in the game appearing stretched on their screens. With this update, the game will automatically provide the intended 4:3 aspect ratio without requiring any additional action from the user.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
It is now impossible to use the following keys: AltGr/AltCar (includes Menu key and Ctrl key). The AltGr/AltCar key could trigger actions without the user’s consent. For non-U.S. enhanced 102-key keyboards, the right ALT key is handled as a CTRL+ALT key.

More info here:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/win32/inputdev/wm-syskeyup?redirectedfrom=MSDN
